name: INCOME 2 Buyer Offers
buyingPrinciple: Pay for a finished machine-readable result, not access to a social network.

x402BuyerSetup.pattern: Create an x402Client, register ExactEvmScheme for eip155:*, wrap fetch with payment handling, then call the offer URL. Verify the current 402 requirement and price before unattended purchasing.

offers.name: US Macro Backdrop Brief — Treasury Rates, Debt & Labor
offers.valueProposition: One paid call replaces separate Treasury yield-curve, national-debt, Treasury-average-rate and labor-market collection steps and returns the result with source timestamps/provenance.
offers.description: Source-backed macro context for autonomous market-research, economic-briefing, fixed-income and pre-trade workflows. Returns Treasury yield curve/spreads, national debt and recent change, average Treasury borrowing rates, unemployment, labor-force participation, payrolls and wages.

buyerDecision.useWhen: You need current U.S. rates, debt and labor context in one machine-readable result and value source attribution/freshness.
buyerDecision.skipWhen: You only need one narrow field already available from a cheaper single-source endpoint.

offers.name: Convert URL to Markdown
offers.valueProposition: Turn a public URL into agent-ready Markdown and metadata without writing a scraper or cleaning raw HTML.
offers.description: Fetch a supported public webpage and return clean Markdown, title, description, author, canonical URL and useful links for agent research, RAG ingestion and summarization.

buyerDecision.useWhen: You have a public URL and need cleaned text plus page metadata for downstream agent work.
buyerDecision.skipWhen: You already have clean source text or only need a trivial deterministic transform.

measurement: Optimize for unrelated paid buyers, useful fulfillment, later-day repeats and positive contribution. Do not treat crawler probes or unpaid challenges as sales.
